# Worked example 

Long example on real dataset. 


## Load libraries and data

```{r}
library(alabaster.sfe) 
library(SpatialExperiment)
library(tidyverse)
library(limma)
library(DT)
library(BiocParallel)
library(Voyager)
library(patchwork)

library(pals) # SOme nice colour palettes
library(spicyR)

```

```{r}
data_dir              <- file.path("~/projects/spatialsnippets/datasets/GSE234713_IBDcosmx_GarridoTrigo2023/processed_data") 
sfe_01_loaded <- file.path(data_dir, "GSE234713_CosMx_IBD_sfe_01_loaded")
se_pseudobulk_file <- file.path(data_dir, "GSE234713_CosMx_IBD_pseudobulk_sample_se2.RDS")
```


```{r}
sfe <- readObject(sfe_01_loaded)
```





## Experimental Design 



There are many (too many) of teh detailed celltypes.

```{r}
table(sfe$celltype_SingleR2, sfe$tissue_sample)
```

```{r}
#interesting_celltypes <- c("Colonocytes", "M1", "M2")
#interesting_celltypes <- c("Glia", "M1", "M2", 'Inflammatory fibroblasts', "Inflammatory monocytes" )# , 'PC IgG') 
#interesting_celltypes <- c("B cell","Naïve B cell", "T cells CCL20", "Memory B cell")
interesting_celltypes <- c("Goblet", "Secretory progenitor", "Inflammatory monocytes" , "Macrophage NRG1",  "M0",'M1', "M2")

#interesting_celltypes <- c("Inflammatory monocytes" , "Macrophage NRG1")


sfe$highlight <- ifelse(sfe$celltype_SingleR2 %in% interesting_celltypes , as.character(sfe$celltype_SingleR2), "Other")
sfe$highlight <- factor(sfe$highlight, levels=c(interesting_celltypes, "Other"))


# Want colours for out celltypes, and grey for 'other'
highlight_cols <- c(pals::trubetskoy()[seq.int(from = 1, to=length(interesting_celltypes))], "grey80")
names(highlight_cols) <- levels(sfe$highlight )

```

```{r}
sfe.sample <- sfe[,sfe$tissue_sample == "HC_c"]
sfe.sample2 <- sfe[,sfe$tissue_sample == "CD_c"]
```

```{r}
p1 <- plotSpatialFeature(sfe.sample, "highlight",colGeometryName = "cellSeg") + 
  theme(legend.title=element_blank()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=highlight_cols ) 
p2 <- plotSpatialFeature(sfe.sample2, "highlight",colGeometryName = "cellSeg") + 
  theme(legend.title=element_blank()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=highlight_cols ) 

p1 + p2
```






## pull in niches


load in niches for testing

```{r}
banksy_res_file <- '/home/s.williams/projects/spatial-taster-workshop/data/banksy_res.RDS'
banksy_res <- readRDS(banksy_res_file)

niche_lookup <- setNames(banksy_res$clust_M0_lam0.8_k50_res0.3, nm=as.character( banksy_res$cell ))
sfe$clust_M0_lam0.8_k50_res0.3 <- niche_lookup[as.character(sfe$cell)]
sfe$niche <- factor(paste0('n', as.character(sfe$clust_M0_lam0.8_k50_res0.3)),
                     levels=paste0('n',levels(sfe$clust_M0_lam0.8_k50_res0.3)))


```




```{r}
sfe.sample <- sfe[,sfe$tissue_sample == "HC_c"]
sfe.sample2 <- sfe[,sfe$tissue_sample == "CD_c"]
```

```{r}
p1 <-  plotSpatialFeature(sfe.sample, "niche",colGeometryName = "cellSeg") + 
  theme(legend.title=element_blank())
p2 <- plotSpatialFeature(sfe.sample2, "niche",colGeometryName = "cellSeg") + 
  theme(legend.title=element_blank()) 
p1 + p2
```




Subset to just the one (two) regions to focus on
```{r}
lp_region_niches <- c('n1', 'n2')

sfe.lp <- sfe[,sfe$niche %in% lp_region_niches]

```


Build table for spicy

```{r}

cell_info <- cbind(as.data.frame(colData(sfe.lp)), spatialCoords(sfe.lp))

# Ok, so shoudltreate each fov as an image, since multipels are explictyly supported.
# Or is that assuming true repeated measures?
# But it avoids the issue of going across the jittered edges...so keep it.
#$imageID    <- paste0(as.character(cell_info$samplenum),'_',cell_info$fov)
cell_info$imageID    <- as.character(cell_info$tissue_sample)
cell_info$tissue_sample <-   as.character(cell_info$tissue_sample) # No UC 
  

# rename x,y
cell_info <- cell_info %>% rename(
    x=CenterX_global_px, 
    y=CenterY_global_px,
)
# Check if this is still neccessary
# to avoid error: Error in owinInternalRect(xrange, yrange, ..., unitname = unitname): xrange should be a vector of length 2 giving (xmin, xmax)
min_x <- min(cell_info$x)
min_y <- min(cell_info$y)
if (min_x < 0) {cell_info$x = cell_info$x + -(min_x) + 1 }
if (min_y < 0) {cell_info$y = cell_info$y + -(min_y) + 1 }
  
  
  
  



```





```{r}
spicy_res <- spicy(
          cells     = cell_info ,
          subject   = 'tissue_sample',
          cellType  = 'highlight',
          #sigma     = 20, # explain this
          condition = 'group'
          #from  = "Goblet",
          #to = "M2"
          )
```


```{r}
topPairs(spicy_res )
```

```{r}
signifPlot(spicy_res )

```
